argv: Independent focused review of explicit Wayland client disconnection and graceful close. Frozen worktree based a5542e2; hashes identify actual implementation. Only Read/Grep within snapshot, about 10-14 calls, no commands/network/writes/agents. New Action DisconnectClient requires explicit generational WindowId, strict serde rejects extra fields; no default binding. Resolves live owned wl_surface.client, checks ClientState AtomicBool disconnected, derives affected live toplevel IDs via exact server ClientId; never PID/title/app_id. IPC reports connection-wide scope/other-window loss. apply_action separately validates then kills selected client ConnectionClosed, queues client ID and pings one-shot display callback; no OS signals. Callback's dispatch_single_client must cleanup even if Rust dispatch_all_clients returns with zero readable events. Dispatcher cloned for readable + ping callbacks single-thread ownership/no Rc cycle to loop. Atomic disconnected callback rejects duplicate requests before object destruction. Existing finish_dispatch handles dead windows/popup/layout/focus. Graceful close validates live client and sends only to focused toplevel; refusal does not escalate. Review identity, lifetime, reentrancy, queued cleanup, bounds, failure reporting, IPC sequence and source fixture oracle. Fixture has one victim connection with mapped target/minimized sibling/unmapped target and independent same-process/app-id survivor; close event/frame/navigation then explicit disconnect via UNMAPPED role, poll for HUP with no requests/flush/healthy traffic before transport close, stale-ID rejection sequence unchanged, survivor frames. First quiet-peer negative against general dispatch-only implementation failed, final code uses single-client dispatch. Assess actual source, do not treat author pass statements as runtime proof. Pinned backend/client/display/calloop sources included. Return concise concrete HIGH/MEDIUM findings and useful LOWs with triggers/paths; no broad old-native or resource/security audit. Actual hardware/toolkits/grab/clipboard matrices unqualified.
